useCases: Bootable Media Creation: Generates bootable USB drives from ISO images with support for BIOS and UEFI targets, including GPT and MBR partiti
Format Flexibility: Supports FAT32, NTFS, exFAT, UDF, and ext2/ext3 file systems, with cluster size selection and quick-format options.
ISO Integrity Verification: Validates image checksums and detects corrupted or incomplete ISO files prior to write operations.
readmeSummary: Rufus is a standalone Windows x64 desktop utility engineered for fast, dependable USB drive formatting and bootable media creation.
